_doc: Expected visual profile per slide archetype (loaded by qa/archetypes.py).
Each metric: range [lo, hi] = no penalty inside; soft = how fast fitness decays outside; w = weight (0 = not scored); null = metric not used.
Every change must be recorded in evals/profile_changes.md with reason and evidence; tests/test_quality.py checks that the file and the changelog agree on the last-changed versions.

utilization.why: Content should use most of the body band unless the archetype says otherwise.

empty.why: The largest empty rectangle is the 'floats in an empty slide' failure.

offcentre.why: Visual weight near the body centre.

emphasis.why: Something should stand out (one-sided: primary is also default data ink).

regions.why: Many separate accent masses compete; a highlighted series repeats, so only many masses are noise.

ratio.why: The headline should dominate the body type.

proof.why: Headline numbers / highlighted items visible in the exhibit.

integrity.why: The exhibit must say what the data says: a slide with a visual QA error or a chart that cannot encode its data (labels off the slide, missing negative bars) is broken whatever its layout. Found by human round r3 (expert rater): v1.4 waterfalls with negative totals scored 100.

statement.why: One sentence carries the slide: air is the point, density would be wrong. The statement text IS the message and may be larger than any headline (no hierarchy ratio, no proof).

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

kpi_hero.why: One big figure: intentional whitespace, the figure must dominate. A centred figure leaves empty bands of ~40% of the body; half the slide empty is not intentional.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

kpi_dashboard.why: Several KPIs read as a set: fill the band evenly, emphasis bounded so the tiles do not all shout. A set of 3–5 figures shown as cards needs air like a KPI hero (utilization from 0.5, empty up to 0.36); a dense grid still fills the band.

evidence.development: v1.4 archetype battery (8 dashboard slides, 202_battery_kpi_dashboard.json) after the KPI-card fix
evidence.human: r2 (blind, one evaluator): 2/3 preferred v1.4; strongest scorer-human disagreement of r2 (p034, scorer −26.2 against the human choice). Still provisional.

executive_summary.why: Dense by nature, even rhythm. Short summaries read better as one compact centred block than spread over the full height; a summary using under half the canvas is still too thin.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

chart.why: Solid bars are data ink, not clutter; a line chart is thin by nature.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

waterfall.why: The bridge needs the full width and most of the height for its deltas.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

table.why: A table that floats in half an empty slide is the canonical failure.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

matrix.why: A 2x2 is a square field: balance matters more than filling every corner.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

comparison.why: Columns compared side by side should use the width and stay balanced. Comparison columns are TEXT: the same density expectations as a text exhibit (utilization from 0.55, empty up to 0.35), balance weighted higher.

evidence.development: v1.4 archetype battery (10 comparison slides, 208_battery_comparison.json) after the joint-column composition fix
evidence.human: r2 (blind, ONE evaluator): 7/7 decisive votes preferred v1.4 (pairs on sealed holdout v2 decks). Directional support, not multi-rater validation.

process.why: Steps read left to right across the width. With few, short steps the sequence is a BAND (like a timeline): vertical air above and below a centred band is inherent; the failures are a band glued under the headline (empty) or off-balance (offcentre).

evidence.development: v1.4 archetype battery (10 process slides, evals/regression/cases/209_battery_process.json) after the adaptive-composition fix
evidence.human: r2 (blind, ONE evaluator): 8/8 decisive votes preferred v1.4 (pairs on sealed holdout v2 decks). Directional support, not multi-rater validation.

roadmap.why: Roadmaps read left to right across the whole width.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

timeline.why: A timeline is a one-dimensional band: air above and below it is inherent, not waste.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

operating_model.why: Layered diagrams carry a label column on the left: their ink is left-weighted by construction.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

architecture.why: Layered diagrams carry a label column on the left: their ink is left-weighted by construction.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

hierarchy.why: Trees taper: their envelope leaves corners empty.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

segmentation.why: Mekko / tile map: a full field.

evidence.development: v1.2 calibration set (example decks reviewed slide by slide + regression suite)

text_exhibit.why: Prose: some air is fine, a sliver of text on an empty slide is not.
